% Pattern: number/format. \def\thetheorem in the body of \newenvironment sets
% the format only inside that environment, and the paper keeps the format of
% \newtheorem. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1.1
% want theorem-2 statement/theorem 2.1
\documentclass{article}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[section]
\newcounter{parenttheorem}
\newenvironment{subtheorems}{%
  \refstepcounter{theorem}%
  \setcounter{parenttheorem}{\value{theorem}}%
  \setcounter{theorem}{0}%
  \def\thetheorem{\theparenttheorem\alph{theorem}}%
}{%
  \setcounter{theorem}{\value{parenttheorem}}%
}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{theorem} Every compact space is bounded. \end{theorem}
\section{Two}
\begin{theorem} Every finite space is bounded. \end{theorem}
\end{document}
